title: PharmAgents2: Towards Autonomous End-to-End Drug Discovery
title_zh: PharmAgents2：迈向自主的端到端药物发现

paragraphs.en: PharmAgents2是自主端到端药物发现系统，结合知识增强决策与大规模探索，多项发现获实验验证。 Drug discovery requires continuous scientific decision-making across a vast research space. We introduce PharmAgents2, an autonomous system for end-to-end drug discovery that combines knowledge-enhanced decision-making with organized large-scale exploration. Paper2Skill extracts transferable scientific decision knowledge from public sources and, together with expert-developed skills, supports research decisions. Self-Scaling Discovery expands exploration through parallel agents inheriting research context and decision-making capabilities across targets, scientific hypotheses, and discovery strategies. We introduce PharmAgents-Bench v0.1, comprising 121 questions across nine decision scenarios and three end-to-end tasks assessed with expert-defined process rubrics. PharmAgents2 outperforms evaluated baselines in most decision categories and achieves the highest process scores on all three end-to-end tasks. In three real-world studies, autonomous investigations generated findings subsequently supported by human-executed experiments. For LpxH, PharmAgents2 hypothesized a previously unreported allosteric site and screened compounds against it, identifying a novel inhibitor scaffold with experimentally confirmed inhibitory activity and binding. For JAK1, it prioritized a covalent inhibition strategy and nominated compounds with experimentally demonstrated activity. Starting from a known bioactive molecule, Self-Scaling Discovery explored candidate targets across the proteome and identified a new binding target, with the interaction subsequently confirmed experimentally. PharmAgents2 represents a prototype of a virtual pharmaceutical company, marking a step toward autonomous end-to-end drug discovery.
paragraphs.zh: PharmAgents2是一个自主的端到端药物发现系统，结合知识增强决策与有组织的大规模探索，多项发现已获实验验证。药物发现需要在广阔的研究空间中持续进行科学决策。 我们提出PharmAgents2，一个用于端到端药物发现的自主系统，它将知识增强的决策与有组织的大规模探索相结合。 Paper2Skill从公开来源中提取可迁移的科学决策知识，并与专家开发的技能一起支持研究决策。 自扩展发现（Self-Scaling Discovery）通过并行智能体在各靶点、科学假设和发现策略之间继承研究上下文与决策能力，从而扩展探索范围。 我们提出PharmAgents-Bench v0.1，包含九类决策场景下的121个问题以及三项端到端任务，并采用专家定义的过程评分标准进行评估。 PharmAgents2在大多数决策类别中优于所评估的基线方法，并在全部三项端到端任务上取得最高的过程得分。 在三项真实世界研究中，自主探究所产生的发现随后得到了由人类执行实验的支持。 针对LpxH，PharmAgents2提出了一种此前未被报道的别构位点，并针对该位点筛选化合物，鉴定出一种新型抑制剂骨架，其抑制活性和结合能力均获得实验证实。 针对JAK1，它优先选择了共价抑制策略，并提名的化合物经实验证明具有活性。 从一个已知的生物活性分子出发，自扩展发现在整个蛋白质组中探索候选靶点，并识别出一个新的结合靶点，该相互作用随后得到实验证实。 PharmAgents2代表了虚拟制药公司的一个原型，标志着向自主端到端药物发现迈出了一步。
